acceptance_criteria.statement: With no roles configuration the reviewer is k3.1-pro, family kimi, budget timeout_s 2700 and max_tool_calls 120.
A roles.reviewer model and budget override the defaults while unspecified fields keep them.
settings_from_ctx returns the roles mapping, proving the key is declared in DEFAULTS and reaches the code.
model_family maps Kimi ids to kimi, DeepSeek ids to deepseek, and every other or empty id to unknown.
A PR with any Kimi-authored commit routes to nous:deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 with reason kimi_authored.
A DeepSeek-only authored PR keeps the default Kimi reviewer with reason default.
A PR whose commits include both families refuses with code review_not_independent.
An empty, unknown-model or unrecognised author list refuses with review_not_independent.
author_families folds recorded author models into a family set and reports unknown for an empty list.
Every returned route's family is absent from the author family set.

observable_behavior: reviewer_role({}) returns k3.1-pro / kimi with the 2700 s, 120-call budget
a Kimi-authored PR routes to nous:deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017
an unknown author or a mixed-family PR refuses with review_not_independent
the roles key is delivered through settings.DEFAULTS
outcome.summary: Resolve the outside reviewer from roles.reviewer and route per PR from the recorded author model families: Kimi by default, Nous DeepSeek flash when any commit is Kimi-authored, and a refusal (review_not_independent) when the author is unknown or both families authored the PR.
